summary: preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes shipped 727KB obfuscated payload
details: The package advertises itself as a Vue SSML-editor component but its package.json declares a preinstall hook that runs setup.mjs, which downloads the Bun runtime from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases, extracts it to a temp directory, chmods it executable, and then invokes that freshly-downloaded Bun binary to execute math_init.js — a 727 KB single-line heavily-obfuscated JavaScript blob shipped inside the package (marked '// @bun @bun-cjs' with hex-mangled identifiers, a shuffled string/number array, and an array-rotation decoder function). The obfuscated payload has no relationship to the package's stated purpose of being a Vue SSML editor, is not inspectable by Node-based tooling, and fires automatically on npm install via the preinstall lifecycle. This is the alternate-runtime-dropper pattern: an alien runtime is pulled at install time specifically to execute an opaque payload, bypassing Node-native review.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
